title: Dispatch: ug4i option-catalog feature choices at level-up (Sonnet 5.5, attempt 1)
description:
Slice 1 of eshyra-ug4i: level-up accepts, validates, applies and PERSISTS option-catalog / list feature choices. Design settled by the Claude Captain (2026-10-08); do not re-open it. Worktree .worktrees/eshyra-ug4i.3, branch eshyra-ug4i.3 cut from eshyra-ug4i. Sonnet 5.5, attempt 1.

HARD RULE (srd-fidelity-hard-blocker): never contradict the SRD. Read the feature records (packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/records.json, kind 'feature', data.choices[] incl. inline options[] with prerequisites) and the class progression (class:<x>.data.progression[].advancement) before coding. Do not edit records.json, importer scripts, or anything under packages/core/data/rules-packs.

SCOPE: structured choices whose `from` is a LIST (option ids/labels), with or without inline options[] — categories fightingStyle (fighter 1 via later levels' additional style: champion 10; paladin 2; ranger 2), metamagic (sorcerer 3 and later growth), invocation (warlock 2 and growth with progression invocationsKnown), 'other' (warlock pact-boon 3; hunter options at 3/7/11/15), favoredEnemy / naturalExplorer (ranger growth levels, if the pack carries them at those levels). OUT of this slice (keep fail-closed, as 'unsupported'): expertise (eshyra-ug4i.1), every spell/cantrip category incl. pact-of-the-tome-cantrips and book-of-ancient-secrets rituals (eshyra-ug4i.2), asiOrFeat feat variant, channelDivinity.

DESIGN:
1. Sheet: CharacterSheet (packages/core/src/character/finalizeCharacter.ts) gains optional `featureChoices?: readonly { featureRef: string; choiceId: string; optionIds: readonly string[]; level: number }[]` in acquisition order. Optional, so existing sheets stay valid; check every sheet validator/serializer/schema test (grep CharacterSheet, characterSheetStore, validateCharacterSheet*) and extend validation of the new field (shape, known featureRef format) without rejecting old sheets.
2. Detection (levelUpEngine.ts detectLevelUpRequiredChoices / featureChoiceKind ~L280-310, ~L565+, ~L690-730): for each feature ref gained at the target level AND for count growth of an already-held feature, emit one descriptor per structured list choice. Count: the choice's `choose` when the feature is newly gained; for growth, the delta of the progression column the pack provides (warlock invocationsKnown; verify how sorcerer metamagic growth at 10/17 and ranger favored enemy/natural explorer growth appear in the pack — feature ref repeated on the row, a column, or prose only. If growth exists only as prose, emit an 'unsupported' descriptor naming it rather than skipping it: a silent skip is the failure mode). Descriptor id stays stable (e.g. `level.<n>.feature.<featureSlug>.<choiceId>`), status 'supported', choose = count, from = legal option ids, plus a new optional `options?: { id, name, prerequisite? }[]` for display. Conditional choices: a choice that only applies because of another option (pact-of-the-tome-cantrips when Tome is picked; Book of Ancient Secrets rituals) must be emitted (as unsupported, owned by eshyra-ug4i.2) only when that option is selected in this level-up or already held — never block Chain/Blade warlocks on Tome's cantrips. Remove 'pact-boon', 'eldritch-invocations', 'metamagic' from the blunt suffix denylist only where the structured path covers them; 'fighting-style' kind likewise. Feature improvements (featureImprovementChoices) stay unsupported.
3. Validation of selections (choices: Record<descriptorId, string[]>): exactly `choose` distinct ids from `from`; not already held for that featureRef+choiceId on the sheet (SRD fighting style: "You can't take a Fighting Style option more than once, even if you later get to choose again" — apply across all fightingStyle choices regardless of feature); every structured prerequisite satisfied against the POST-level-up state: kind 'level' (class level after the level-up), kind 'pactBoon' (sheet featureChoices, or the pact boon selected in this same level-up), kind 'cantrip' (sheet.spells contains the ref — check the id format sheet.spells uses). Unknown prerequisite kinds -> refuse the option (fail closed), naming it.
4. Optional warlock invocation replacement (SRD: "when you gain a level in this class, you can choose one of the invocations you know and replace it with another invocation that you could learn at that level"): an optional descriptor (not blocking) on every warlock level-up once at least one invocation is held; the selection is [oldId, newId]; validated like a new pick, and the old one must be held. Persist by updating that featureChoices entry (record the replacement in the ledger change set).
5. Apply: applied choices go into changeSet.choicesApplied (widen LevelUpAppliedChoice.kind) and the sheet's featureChoices; the progression ledger row carries them (existing recordProgressionEvent). No mechanical effect of the chosen options is implemented here (Archery +2 etc. stay DM-adjudicated); say so in the doc comment.
6. Guided flow (packages/core/src/character/guidedLevelUpFlow.ts) and any CLI level-up command (grep packages/cli for level-up / levelUp) must present the new descriptors with option names and prerequisites and pass selections through; follow how ASI/subclass are collected there.
7. Docs: update the levelUpEngine header comments and any docs/ page describing level-up choices (grep docs for 'fighting-style' / 'class-feature-choice' / 'level-up').

EVIDENCE TESTS (extend the existing level-up tests; grep detectLevelUpRequiredChoices / applyLevelUp in packages/core/test): warlock 2 -> two invocations (prerequisite-free accepted; an Eldritch-Blast-requiring one refused without the cantrip, accepted with it; a level-5 prerequisite refused at 2); warlock 3 -> pact boon persisted on the sheet; Tome selection blocks on unsupported tome cantrips while Chain does not; warlock 5 invocation growth detected from invocationsKnown (+1 pick) — NOTE spell selection still blocks warlock 5 as unsupported, so assert the descriptor, not a full apply, unless the test fixture avoids spell growth; invocation requiring Pact of the Chain accepted after Chain is held; replacement swaps one; sorcerer 3 metamagic two picks; paladin/ranger 2 fighting style; champion 10 additional fighting style cannot repeat the level-2... (fighter's level-1 style is not stored by creation yet: when the sheet has none recorded, accept any; filed as eshyra-nnj6); duplicate/too-few/too-many/unknown ids refused naming the descriptor; old sheets without featureChoices load and level. Assert identities, not counts.

VERIFY: npm ci in the worktree, npm run verify:worktree BEFORE committing. Commit 'eshyra-ug4i.3 Apply option-catalog feature choices at level-up' ending with 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>'.

Growth findings: warlock invocations = invocationsKnown column delta (descriptor choose=delta); sorcerer metamagic = featureGrant ref REPEATED at 10/17 with choices[].choose still 2 (template) so SRD prose 'another one' is encoded as REPEATED_GRANT_PICKS metamagic=1 (unknown repeated category -> unsupported descriptor); ranger favored enemy/natural explorer growth (6/10/14) = featureImprovement rows only, no option structure -> left as existing unsupported descriptors (not skipped); hunter options and champion additional style are subclass features (not in class row featureRefs) -> detected via existing/selected subclass features (selected-in-same-level-up via new optional selections arg to detectLevelUpRequiredChoices). DEVIATIONS: (1) conditional Tome cantrips / Book of Ancient Secrets rituals emitted unsupported only when picked in THIS level-up, not 'already held' (a held pick passed that block at its own level; re-emitting would block forever); Book of Ancient Secrets keyed on the invocation option id. (2) Persistence tests for casters use a test resolver holding spell growth constant because spell-selection (ug4i.2) still blocks warlock/sorcerer levels; champion 9->10 and fighter apply run unmodified. (3) Legacy suffix denylist kept as fallback only for features the structured path did not cover. Not done: no mechanical effects (DM-adjudicated); expertise, spells, feat variant, channelDivinity stay fail-closed.
